route: New headless Chromium using Python 3.11 Playwright; rendered DOM + urllib-served /api/live-copy-summary; no engine import; read-only.

results.missing_route: The live-copy page exposes only wallet summary in the captured view; no verified expanded-detail exposure field or value was captured. The summary API real_copy_positions has position_value null for sampled rows. A row-specific expansion/field mapping is needed.

results.probe: DOM and API capture verified; API execution_quality_rows contains coin and other fields, but the rendered DOM capture did not capture the friction detail surface.

results.probe: DOM and API capture verified; API execution_quality_rows sampled rows show fill_avg_px null for pending attempts, but no rendered DOM friction-fill field was captured.
results.missing_route: No rendered friction detail row with a copy fill price and matching independent API/oracle source was captured.

results.probe: DOM and API capture verified; no rendered field or independent recomputation for fill-vs-limit bps was captured.

results.probe: Rendered OWNED COPY POSITIONS table (raw/rows_probe.json, table index 2) contains WALLET, COIN, SIDE, SIGNED SIZE; sampled 0G row displays SHORT / -3 and served API owned_copy_positions for that wallet+coin also says SHORT / signed_size -3. This is not an independent check against the register-specified manual_live_positions.json source.
results.missing_route: The on-disk manual_live_positions.json oracle at the proven audit path contains only a ZWIRE sleeve for a synthetic 0xaaaa… wallet, not the displayed 0G wallet+coin row. No shared wallet+coin sample exists across DOM and the independent manual ledger, so the expected sign(manual signed_size) contract cannot be certified.

limitations: Probe was a read-only observation of the live service; no controls or order actions were used.
All six rows remain NOT_TESTED because at least one required rendered-to-independent-source mapping is missing; no row is represented as a pass or failure.
